english: Let $y=y(x)$ be the solution of the differential equation $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{1-y}{x+2y-3}$ with $y(3)=\dfrac12$. The solution curve meets the line $x+y=5$ at a point $(a,b)$. Then the value of $b$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $y=y(x)$ अवकल समीकरण $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{1-y}{x+2y-3}$ का वह हल है जिसके लिए $y(3)=\dfrac12$ है। हल वक्र रेखा $x+y=5$ से बिन्दु $(a,b)$ पर मिलता है। तब $b$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: The lines $1-y=0$ and $x+2y-3=0$ intersect at $(1,1)$. Shift the origin: $x=X+1$, $y=Y+1$. Then $1-y=-Y$ and $x+2y-3=X+2Y$, so $\dfrac{dY}{dX}=\dfrac{-Y}{X+2Y}$, which is homogeneous.
Separate: $\dfrac{1+2v}{v(1+v)}\,dv=-\dfrac{2\,dX}{X}$. The numerator is the derivative of $v(1+v)$, so $\ln\left|v(1+v)\right|=-2\ln\left|X\right|+c$ and $v(1+v)X^{2}=K$.
Since $v(1+v)X^{2}=Y(X+Y)$, the solutions are $Y(X+Y)=K$, that is, $(y-1)(x+y-2)=K$.
At $(3,\frac12)$: $(-\frac12)(\frac32)=-\frac34$, so $K=-\frac34$. On this branch $Y<0$ throughout (it cannot reach $Y=0$ because $K\neq0$), and $X=-\frac{3}{4Y}-Y$.
The line $x+y=5$ is $X+Y=3$. Then $3Y=-\frac34$, $Y=-\frac14$, and $X=3-Y=\frac{13}{4}$, so the point is $\left(\frac{17}{4},\frac34\right)$; it is the only intersection.
originality_note: New: a reducible-to-homogeneous equation whose solutions are the hyperbolas (y - 1)(x + y - 2) = K, so the curve meets the line x + y = 5 where it meets X + Y = 3 and Y follows at once (way 4). Closest known: dy/dx = (2x - y + 1)/(x + 2y - 3) type exercises. Different because: the numerator has no x term, the integral is a log of v(1 + v), and the chosen line is parallel to an asymptotic direction of the solution, which makes the intersection linear.

concept_use.Homogeneous differential equations: After the shift the equation dY/dX = -Y/(X + 2Y) is homogeneous and is solved by Y = vX and separation.
concept_use.Equations reducible to homogeneous form:: The numerator and denominator are linear expressions whose lines meet at (1,1); shifting the origin there is the reduction to homogeneous form.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and function introduced with its domain, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; the solution branch through (3, 1/2) has Y < 0 and meets x + y = 5 once; answer 0.75 is a decimal between 0 and 1 as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Shift to (1,1), Y = vX, get Y(X + Y) = K.
justification: Standard reduction and a separable log integral, then one substitution: a routine chain. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q9 (L2).
